# ReadingProgress

A thin bar that fills as the reader moves through the text.

```tsx
import { ReadingProgress } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- At the top of long reads (more than a few screens) to show how much is left.

## When not to

- As the only way to know where you are: a table of contents or headings also help.
- On short pages.
- To show progress of a task such as a form: it is for reading position.

## Examples

### Controlled value

Pass `value` (0 to 100) when you track progress yourself. `position="static"` keeps the bar in the flow.

```tsx
<div className="flex max-w-md flex-col gap-4">
  <ReadingProgress value={0} position="static" label="Progreso 0" />
  <ReadingProgress value={40} position="static" label="Progreso 40" />
  <ReadingProgress value={100} position="static" label="Progreso 100" />
</div>
```

### Follows the scroll

Without `value`, the bar fixes itself to the top of the viewport and follows the page (or `targetRef`, the element being read).

```tsx
<ReadingProgress label="Progreso de la página" />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` |  | Progress from 0 to 100. When omitted, the bar follows the scroll position through `targetRef` (or the whole page). |
| `targetRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` |  | The element being read. Progress is how far its content has scrolled past the top of the viewport. |
| `position` | `'fixed' \| 'static'` | `'fixed'` | `fixed` sticks to the top of the viewport; `static` sits in the flow (for layouts that place it themselves). |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name. Defaults to the localised "Reading progress". |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **Role:** `progressbar` with an accessible name, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuenow` (rounded).
- **Contrast:** the gold fill is 3:1 against the page (non-text contrast).
- **Reduced motion:** the width transition is removed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Performance:** scroll updates are throttled to one per animation frame, with passive listeners.

## Content

- Give it an accessible name that says what it measures ("Progreso de lectura").

Component tokens, all aliasing semantic tokens (see [tokens.md](../tokens.md)). CSS variable = `--kafka-` + the path in kebab-case.
